sql:
SELECT AVG(t.average_rating) AS avg_rating
FROM titles t
WHERE t.title_type = 'movie'
  AND t.start_year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999
  AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
summary: 共发现 0 个性能问题。SQL 为单表聚合查询（AVG），返回单行结果，无需 LIMIT；无 SELECT *、无笛卡尔积、无函数包裹列、无子查询、无 NOT IN、无 DISTINCT、无 LIKE 通配符、无 OR 条件。性能良好，无需优化。
